## Change and reason

Identify the affected section or XML anchor and any related issue.

## Checks

Note the checks run (`make review`, `make check`, `make test`, `make build`)
or any that could not be run. Do not edit the published snapshot.

See CONTRIBUTING.md for IETF contribution terms, attribution, and privacy.

## Related report and disposition

Use `Related to #N` while review remains open. Describe the addressed concern,
remaining questions, and exact source used for checks. See ISSUE-PROCESS.md.
A merge does not establish contributor endorsement or publish a new I-D.
